shared_elements: hands raised or held before the body
figure occupying an upright rectangular slab field
ornamental band or register dividing the field
justification: Both depict an upright monolith bearing a human figure with elaborate headgear accompanied by dense non-alphabetic sign clusters, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A shows two figures strictly in flat profile facing one another across an offering stand, with signs in ordered horizontal registers below, whereas B shows a single frontal, symmetrically posed figure engulfed in deeply modelled scroll and mask ornament with no linear text registers — the depiction conventions (profile flat outline vs frontal high-relief accretion) are entirely different.
